items.briefing:
Australian finance teams are being urged to stay alert to payment scams, with warnings that staff handling invoices and transfers are a key target for fraudsters. Scammers are increasingly impersonating suppliers or clients to redirect payments, exploiting gaps in verification processes that many organisations overlook.

If you receive a request to update payment details — even if it looks legitimate — always verify directly with the sender using a known phone number before acting. Don't rely solely on email to confirm financial changes.

featured.title: Cross-border checkout has a data quality problem
featured.summary: Poor data at checkout is fuelling cost surprises, missed deliveries and fraud fears that are turning many cross-border shoppers away.
